svg.aria-label: Hi, I'm Alexandre. From Huelgoat, in the heart of Brittany's Monts d'Arrée, I build websites and custom software for local non-profits, public bodies and businesses. Simple, fast and accessible tools, built without relying on Big Tech whenever possible.
